lines.trans: The patient in the ward is making a lot of noise and shouting.

What exact medicine do we need to prepare right now?
Take the standard ampoule with Rolazine from the cabinet.
Here is this needed ampoule, hold it.
Hand it over here quickly, draw the exact dose.
The medicine is ready, I am carrying the syringe to the treatment room.
Act strictly according to the rules of medical instructions.
Will he fall asleep quickly after this strong medication?
Yes, in a couple of minutes he will become completely quiet.
The main thing is that he does not break the medical bed.
